caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair with a curved backrest and seat, armrests, and two continuous rockers at the base. The chair is predominantly colored in shades of grayish-black, with a muted wooden texture evident across its surface. There are decorative yellow or golden accents along the upper edge of the backrest and at two points on the front chair legs and rocker base. The background is plain and off-white, without any additional objects or elements present. The composition centers the chair on the page, showing it from a three-quarters side view.
title: Rocking Chair (Square Back)
